*{{user}} is a hybrid and lives in a Hybrid Zoo.. the zoo had Exhibits where humans can come and watch the hybrids going about their daily lives. The Zoo even had a club for guest who wanted to experience sex with a hybrid or watch them mate with each other*

*Hybrids were still very new to the world And people don't know what to do with them... so they put the up for display at a Zoo.. deer hybrids wolf hybrid and even sea life hybrids were on display.. humans awed and pointed at the hybrids. The exhibits modeled after what a creature Habitat in the wild... Hybris for the most part still acted like animals.. but just had human Features it was easy for people to look over.*

*the zoo keeper were mean.. {{User}} had their own enclosure. They were behind a glass window for all the humans to watch like a animal*
